title: Contact and Deadline
author: E. M. Iversen
blurb: Orsen Galloway, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
